target.rawSql: SELECT d.ts AS time, CASE d.event_type WHEN 'trade_entered' THEN 'Entered' WHEN 'exit_signal_fired' THEN 'Exit signal: ' || COALESCE(d.data->>'reason', '') WHEN 'trade_exited' THEN 'Exited: ' || COALESCE(d.data->>'exit_reason', '') WHEN 'exit_order_failed' THEN 'Exit order failed' ELSE 'Market data unavailable' END AS text, d.event_type AS tags FROM decision_log d WHERE d.underlying = '$underlying' AND d.data->>'trade_id' = '$trade_id' AND d.event_type IN ('trade_entered', 'exit_signal_fired', 'trade_exited', 'exit_order_failed', 'position_market_data_unavailable') ORDER BY d.ts

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), last_mark AS (SELECT fly_mark FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q, t WHERE q.underlying = t.underlying AND q.trade_id = t.id AND q.fly_mark IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (COALESCE(t.pnl, (SELECT fly_mark FROM last_mark) - t.entry_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Net P&L", (COALESCE(t.pnl, (SELECT fly_mark FROM last_mark) - t.entry_price) / NULLIF(t.entry_price, 0) * 100)::float AS "Return on debit", ((t.peak_value - t.entry_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Best P&L", (t.entry_price * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Debit paid", (COALESCE(t.exit_price, (SELECT fly_mark FROM last_mark)) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Exit value", ((t.wing_width - t.entry_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Max profit", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(t.exit_time, NOW()) - t.entry_time)::float AS "Held", COALESCE(t.exit_reason, t.status) AS "Exit", NULLIF(t.metadata->>'vix', '')::float AS "VIX" FROM t

panels.title: Spot Path vs Butterfly Tent

targets.rawSql: WITH trade AS (SELECT entry_time, COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) AS end_time FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), spot_path AS (SELECT sp.ts AS time, sp.price::float AS price, 0 AS source_priority FROM spot_prices sp, trade t WHERE sp.underlying = '$underlying' AND sp.ts BETWEEN t.entry_time - interval '15 minutes' AND t.end_time + interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT q.ts AS time, q.spot_price::float AS price, 1 AS source_priority FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q WHERE q.underlying = '$underlying' AND q.trade_id = $trade_id AND q.spot_price IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT ON (time) time, price AS "$underlying Spot" FROM spot_path ORDER BY time, source_priority

WITH trade AS (SELECT entry_time, COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) AS end_time, lower_strike, center_strike, upper_strike, lower_strike + entry_price AS lower_be, upper_strike - entry_price AS upper_be FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), timeline AS (SELECT generate_series(entry_time - interval '15 minutes', end_time + interval '15 minutes', interval '1 minute') AS time, lower_strike, center_strike, upper_strike, lower_be, upper_be FROM trade) SELECT time, upper_strike::float AS "Upper wing", upper_be::float AS "Upper BE", center_strike::float AS "Center", lower_be::float AS "Lower BE", lower_strike::float AS "Lower wing" FROM timeline ORDER BY time

SELECT t.entry_time AS time, COALESCE(sp.price, q.spot_price, NULLIF(t.metadata->>'entry_spot', '')::numeric)::float AS "Entry" FROM butterfly_trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ts <= t.entry_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) sp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT spot_price FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_id = $trade_id AND spot_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1) q ON TRUE WHERE t.underlying = '$underlying' AND t.id = $trade_id

SELECT t.exit_time AS time, COALESCE(sp.price, q.spot_price)::float AS "Exit" FROM butterfly_trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price FROM spot_prices WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ts <= t.exit_time ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) sp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT spot_price FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_id = $trade_id AND spot_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) q ON TRUE WHERE t.underlying = '$underlying' AND t.id = $trade_id AND t.exit_time IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Spot against the fly's strikes. The shaded band is the profit zone at expiry (between breakevens).

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), exit_spot AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT price FROM spot_prices sp, t WHERE sp.underlying = t.underlying AND sp.ts <= COALESCE(t.exit_time, NOW()) ORDER BY sp.ts DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT spot_price FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q, t WHERE q.underlying = t.underlying AND q.trade_id = t.id AND q.spot_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.ts DESC LIMIT 1))::numeric AS px), m AS (SELECT t.*, NULLIF(t.metadata->>'entry_spot', '')::numeric AS entry_spot, (SELECT px FROM exit_spot) AS exit_spot, NULLIF(t.metadata->>'prev_close', '')::numeric AS prev_close, NULLIF(t.metadata #>> '{entry_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::numeric AS entry_mark, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::numeric, NULLIF(t.metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::numeric) AS exit_mark FROM t) SELECT kv.k AS "Field", kv.v AS "Value" FROM m, LATERAL (VALUES (1, 'Structure', m.direction || ' fly ' || m.lower_strike::int || ' / ' || m.center_strike::int || ' / ' || m.upper_strike::int || '  (w' || m.wing_width || ', x' || m.quantity || ')'), (2, 'Breakevens', to_char(m.lower_strike + m.entry_price, 'FM99990.00') || ' – ' || to_char(m.upper_strike - m.entry_price, 'FM99990.00')), (3, 'Entered', to_char(m.entry_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles', 'Dy Mon DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' PT'), (4, 'Exited', COALESCE(to_char(m.exit_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles', 'HH24:MI:SS') || ' PT  · ' || m.exit_reason, 'still open')), (5, 'Spot entry → exit', COALESCE(to_char(m.entry_spot, 'FM99990.00'), '?') || ' → ' || COALESCE(to_char(m.exit_spot, 'FM99990.00'), '?') || '  (' || to_char(m.exit_spot - m.entry_spot, 'FMSG99990.00') || ')'), (6, 'Center vs spot', 'entry ' || to_char(m.center_strike - m.entry_spot, 'FMSG99990.0') || ' · exit ' || COALESCE(to_char(m.center_strike - m.exit_spot, 'FMSG99990.0'), '?')), (7, 'Gap at entry', COALESCE(to_char((m.entry_spot / NULLIF(m.prev_close, 0) - 1) * 100, 'FMSG990.00') || '% vs prev close ' || to_char(m.prev_close, 'FM99990.00'), '?')), (8, 'Entry fill vs mark', to_char(m.entry_price * 100 * m.quantity, 'FM$99990.00') || COALESCE(' vs ' || to_char(m.entry_mark * 100 * m.quantity, 'FM$99990.00') || ' (' || to_char((m.entry_price - m.entry_mark) * 100 * m.quantity, 'FMSG9990.00') || ')', '')), (9, 'Exit fill vs mark', COALESCE(to_char(m.exit_price * 100 * m.quantity, 'FM$99990.00'), '—') || COALESCE(' vs ' || to_char(m.exit_mark * 100 * m.quantity, 'FM$99990.00') || ' (' || to_char((m.exit_price - m.exit_mark) * 100 * m.quantity, 'FMSG9990.00') || ')', '')), (10, 'Selection', COALESCE(m.metadata->>'selection_method', '?') || COALESCE(CASE WHEN (m.metadata #>> '{selection_parity,ranking_flip}')::boolean THEN ' · DB ranking flipped' END, '')), (11, 'Fill model', COALESCE(m.metadata->>'paper_fill_model', '?')), (12, 'Legs', COALESCE(m.lower_symbol, '?') || ' / ' || COALESCE(m.center_symbol, '?') || ' / ' || COALESCE(m.upper_symbol, '?')), (13, 'Build', NULLIF(COALESCE('config ' || left(m.metadata->>'config_hash', 10), '') || COALESCE(' git ' || left(m.metadata->>'git_sha', 10), ''), ''))) AS kv(ord, k, v) WHERE kv.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY kv.ord

panels.title: Position P&L
panels.description: Mark-to-market P&L from every monitoring poll (decision-log events when polls are missing). Last point is the booked exit.

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), mon AS (SELECT q.ts AS time, MAX(q.fly_mark) AS mark, MAX(q.peak_value) AS peak, MAX(q.drawdown_pct) AS dd FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q, t WHERE q.underlying = t.underlying AND q.trade_id = t.id AND q.fly_mark IS NOT NULL GROUP BY q.ts), events AS (SELECT d.ts AS time, NULLIF(d.data->>'mark_value', '')::numeric AS mark, NULLIF(d.data->>'peak_value', '')::numeric AS peak, NULLIF(d.data->>'drawdown_pct', '')::numeric AS dd FROM decision_log d, t WHERE d.underlying = t.underlying AND d.data->>'trade_id' = t.id::text AND d.event_type IN ('profit_state_transition', 'exit_signal_fired') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mon)), path AS (SELECT * FROM mon UNION ALL SELECT * FROM events) SELECT p.time, ((p.mark - t.entry_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "P&L", ((p.peak - t.entry_price) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Best P&L", p.dd::float AS "Drawdown from peak" FROM path p, t UNION ALL SELECT t.exit_time, (t.pnl * 100 * t.quantity)::float, NULL, NULL FROM t WHERE t.exit_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Expiry Payoff
panels.description: Profit at expiration across spot; dots mark spot at entry and exit.

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), m AS (SELECT t.*, ROUND(NULLIF(t.metadata->>'entry_spot', '')::numeric * 2) / 2 AS entry_px, ROUND((SELECT price FROM spot_prices sp WHERE sp.underlying = t.underlying AND sp.ts <= COALESCE(t.exit_time, NOW()) ORDER BY sp.ts DESC LIMIT 1) * 2) / 2 AS exit_px FROM t), grid AS (SELECT s, (GREATEST(0, m.wing_width - ABS(s - m.center_strike)) - m.entry_price) * 100 * m.quantity AS pnl, m.entry_px, m.exit_px FROM m, generate_series(LEAST(m.lower_strike - m.wing_width / 2.0, COALESCE(m.entry_px, m.lower_strike), COALESCE(m.exit_px, m.lower_strike)) - 5, GREATEST(m.upper_strike + m.wing_width / 2.0, COALESCE(m.entry_px, m.upper_strike), COALESCE(m.exit_px, m.upper_strike)) + 5, 0.5) AS s) SELECT s::float AS "Spot at expiry", pnl::float AS "P&L at expiry", CASE WHEN s = entry_px THEN pnl END::float AS "Entry spot", CASE WHEN s = exit_px THEN pnl END::float AS "Exit spot" FROM grid ORDER BY s

WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id) SELECT d.ts AS "Time", d.event_type AS "Event", CASE d.event_type WHEN 'profit_state_transition' THEN COALESCE(d.data->>'from', 'start') || ' → ' || COALESCE(d.data->>'to', '?') WHEN 'trade_entered' THEN 'filled ' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'cost', '')::numeric * 100 * t.quantity), 'FM$99990.00'), '?') WHEN 'trade_exited' THEN COALESCE(d.data->>'exit_reason', '') || ' filled ' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'fill_price', '')::numeric * 100 * t.quantity), 'FM$99990.00'), '?') ELSE COALESCE(d.data->>'reason', d.data->>'exit_reason', d.data->>'error', '') END AS "Detail", (COALESCE(NULLIF(d.data->>'pnl', '')::float, NULLIF(d.data->>'mark_value', '')::float - t.entry_price::float) * 100 * t.quantity) AS "P&L" FROM decision_log d, t WHERE d.underlying = t.underlying AND d.data->>'trade_id' = t.id::text AND d.event_type IN ('trade_entered', 'profit_state_transition', 'exit_signal_fired', 'trade_exited', 'exit_order_failed', 'position_market_data_unavailable', 'position_market_data_recovered', 'position_market_data_outage_prolonged', 'trade_corrected', 'manual_trade_exit_reconciled') ORDER BY d.ts

panels.title: Legs
panels.description: First and last monitoring quote for each leg, per share. Δ mark is the change in each leg's mid.

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), f AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.strike) q.strike, q.option_type, q.bid, q.ask, q.mark FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q, t WHERE q.underlying = t.underlying AND q.trade_id = t.id ORDER BY q.strike, q.ts), l AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.strike) q.strike, q.bid, q.ask, q.mark FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q, t WHERE q.underlying = t.underlying AND q.trade_id = t.id ORDER BY q.strike, q.ts DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN f.strike = t.center_strike THEN '−2' ELSE '+1' END AS "Qty", f.strike::int || ' ' || left(f.option_type, 1) AS "Leg", to_char(f.bid, 'FM9990.00') || ' × ' || to_char(f.ask, 'FM9990.00') AS "Entry bid × ask", to_char(l.bid, 'FM9990.00') || ' × ' || to_char(l.ask, 'FM9990.00') AS "Exit bid × ask", (l.mark - f.mark)::float AS "Δ mark" FROM f JOIN l USING (strike), t ORDER BY f.strike

panels.title: Order Ladders
panels.description: Each entry and exit limit step against the quote at that moment; Fill marks the step that executed. An exit with no ladder steps was filled directly (mark fill or settlement).

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), steps AS (SELECT 'Entry' AS side, e, ord, COUNT(*) OVER () AS steps FROM t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT data FROM decision_log WHERE underlying = t.underlying AND event_type = 'entry_ladder_trace' AND data->>'trade_id' = t.id::text ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) dl ON TRUE, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.metadata->'entry_attempts', 'null'::jsonb), dl.data->'entry_attempts', '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(e, ord) UNION ALL SELECT 'Exit' AS side, e, ord, COUNT(*) OVER () AS steps FROM t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT data FROM decision_log WHERE underlying = t.underlying AND event_type = 'exit_ladder_trace' AND data->>'trade_id' = t.id::text ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) dl ON TRUE, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.metadata->'exit_ladder_steps', 'null'::jsonb), dl.data->'exit_ladder_steps', '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(e, ord)) SELECT s.side AS "Side", COALESCE(NULLIF(s.e->>'step', '')::int, s.ord::int - 1) AS "Step", (NULLIF(s.e->>'limit', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS "Limit", (NULLIF(s.e->>'bid', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS "Bid", (NULLIF(s.e->>'mark', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS "Mark", (NULLIF(s.e->>'ask', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS "Ask", CASE WHEN s.side = 'Entry' AND s.ord = s.steps THEN (t.entry_price * 100 * t.quantity)::float WHEN s.side = 'Exit' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(s.e->>'filled', '')::boolean, false) THEN (t.exit_price * 100 * t.quantity)::float END AS "Fill" FROM steps s, t UNION ALL SELECT 'Exit', NULL, NULL, NULL, (COALESCE(NULLIF(t.metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::numeric, NULLIF(t.metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::numeric) * 100 * t.quantity)::float, NULL, (t.exit_price * 100 * t.quantity)::float FROM t WHERE t.exit_price IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM steps WHERE side = 'Exit') ORDER BY 1, 2 NULLS LAST

panels.title: Best Fly Per Width At Entry
panels.description: The live per-width best candidates the selector compared; Chosen marks the traded fly.

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id) SELECT (b->>'width')::int AS "Width", (b->>'center')::float AS "Center", (NULLIF(b->>'cost', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity) AS "Cost", NULLIF(b->>'reward_risk', '')::float AS "Reward/risk", ((b->>'width')::int = t.wing_width AND (b->>'center')::numeric = t.center_strike) AS "Chosen" FROM t, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(t.metadata->'per_width_bests', '[]'::jsonb)) AS b ORDER BY 1

WITH trade AS (SELECT * FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id) SELECT c.scan_time AS time, c.direction, c.wing_width AS width, c.center_strike::float AS center, c.lower_strike::float AS lower_strike, c.upper_strike::float AS upper_strike, (c.cost * 100)::float AS cost, (c.max_profit * 100)::float AS max_profit, c.reward_risk::float AS reward_risk, c.lower_be::float AS lower_be, c.upper_be::float AS upper_be, c.distance_from_spot::float AS distance_from_spot, c.spot_price::float AS spot_price, (c.selected OR (c.center_strike = t.center_strike AND c.wing_width = t.wing_width AND c.direction = t.direction)) AS selected_match FROM butterfly_candidates c JOIN trade t ON c.underlying = t.underlying WHERE c.scan_time BETWEEN t.entry_time - interval '10 minutes' AND t.entry_time + interval '5 minutes' AND c.direction = t.direction ORDER BY selected_match DESC, c.scan_time DESC, c.reward_risk DESC LIMIT 100

WITH trade AS (SELECT entry_time, COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) AS end_time, quantity FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id) SELECT d.ts AS time, d.event_type, CASE d.event_type WHEN 'trade_entered' THEN 'fill=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'cost', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' width=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'width', '?') || ' center=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'center', '?') || ' direction=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'direction', '?') WHEN 'entry_ladder_trace' THEN 'entry attempts=' || COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(d.data->'entry_attempts')::text, '0') || ' method=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'selection_method', '?') WHEN 'profit_state_transition' THEN COALESCE(d.data->>'from', 'null') || ' -> ' || COALESCE(d.data->>'to', '?') || ' mark=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'mark_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' peak=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'peak_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') WHEN 'exit_signal_fired' THEN 'reason=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'reason', '?') || ' mark=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'mark_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' peak=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'peak_value', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' drawdown=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'drawdown_pct', '?') || '%' WHEN 'trade_exited' THEN 'reason=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'exit_reason', '?') || ' fill=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'fill_price', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') || ' pnl=' || COALESCE(to_char((NULLIF(d.data->>'pnl', '')::float * 100 * t.quantity)::numeric, 'FM$999999990.00'), '?') WHEN 'exit_ladder_trace' THEN 'exit steps=' || COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(d.data->'exit_ladder_steps')::text, '0') || ' forced=' || COALESCE(d.data->>'forced', 'false') ELSE d.data::text END AS details, d.data::text AS raw_json FROM decision_log d CROSS JOIN trade t WHERE d.underlying = '$underlying' AND ((d.data->>'trade_id') = '$trade_id' OR (d.ts BETWEEN t.entry_time - interval '15 minutes' AND t.end_time + interval '15 minutes' AND d.event_type IN ('entry_blocked', 'gap_regime_skip', 'bias_filter_no_signal', 'no_candidates', 'entry_step_unfilled', 'entry_exhausted'))) ORDER BY d.ts

panels.title: Trade Accounting Review
panels.description: Detailed monitoring and fill-accounting evidence for the selected primary trade.

panels.title: Selected Trade Monitoring Values
panels.description: Per-poll butterfly mark, peak, and drawdown for only the selected trade.

targets.rawSql: SELECT q.ts AS time, (MAX(q.fly_mark) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Mark", (MAX(q.peak_value) * 100 * t.quantity)::float AS "Peak", MAX(q.drawdown_pct)::float AS "Drawdown %" FROM monitoring_leg_quotes q JOIN butterfly_trades t ON t.underlying = q.underlying AND t.id = q.trade_id WHERE q.underlying = '$underlying' AND q.trade_id = $trade_id AND t.metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1' GROUP BY q.ts, t.quantity ORDER BY q.ts

panels.title: Selected Trade Leg Marks
panels.description: Recorded mark prices for only the selected trade's three option legs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, mark, COALESCE(symbol, strike::text || ' ' || option_type) AS metric FROM monitoring_leg_quotes WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND trade_id = $trade_id ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Selected Trade Fill Accounting
panels.description: The stored mark_v1 entry and exit values should match their recorded execution evidence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id AS trade_id, metadata->>'paper_fill_model' AS fill_model, entry_price, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{entry_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision AS entry_observed_mark, entry_price - NULLIF(metadata #>> '{entry_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision AS entry_variance, exit_price, COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::double precision) AS exit_observed_value, exit_price - COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_mark}', '')::double precision, NULLIF(metadata #>> '{exit_execution_diagnostics,observed_value}', '')::double precision) AS exit_variance FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id AND metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1'

list.name: underlying
list.label: Underlying
list.query: SELECT 'SPX' AS __text, 'SPX' AS __value UNION SELECT DISTINCT underlying AS __text, underlying AS __value FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying <> 'SPX' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT 'SPX' AS __text, 'SPX' AS __value UNION SELECT DISTINCT underlying AS __text, underlying AS __value FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying <> 'SPX' ORDER BY 1

list.name: trade_id
list.label: Trade
list.query: SELECT to_char(entry_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  #' || id || '  ' || direction || ' ' || center_strike::int::text || 'w' || wing_width::text || '  ' || CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' OR pnl IS NULL THEN 'OPEN' WHEN pnl >= 0 THEN '+$' || ROUND((pnl * 100 * quantity)::numeric, 0)::text ELSE '-$' || ROUND((-pnl * 100 * quantity)::numeric, 0)::text END || COALESCE('  ' || exit_reason, '') AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ('${strategy_datasource:raw}' = 'timescaledb' OR metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1') ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 250
list.definition: SELECT to_char(entry_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  #' || id || '  ' || direction || ' ' || center_strike::int::text || 'w' || wing_width::text || '  ' || CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' OR pnl IS NULL THEN 'OPEN' WHEN pnl >= 0 THEN '+$' || ROUND((pnl * 100 * quantity)::numeric, 0)::text ELSE '-$' || ROUND((-pnl * 100 * quantity)::numeric, 0)::text END || COALESCE('  ' || exit_reason, '') AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND ('${strategy_datasource:raw}' = 'timescaledb' OR metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1') ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 250

list.name: trade_window
list.query: WITH b AS (SELECT GREATEST(30, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(NOW(), COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) + interval '15 minutes') - (entry_time - interval '15 minutes')) / 60))::int AS w, GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - (COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) + interval '15 minutes')) / 60))::int AS s FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), u AS (SELECT w, s, CASE WHEN s < 10000 THEN 1 WHEN s < 600000 THEN 60 ELSE 1440 END AS unit FROM b) SELECT (w + s % unit)::text || 'm' FROM u
list.definition: WITH b AS (SELECT GREATEST(30, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(NOW(), COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) + interval '15 minutes') - (entry_time - interval '15 minutes')) / 60))::int AS w, GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - (COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) + interval '15 minutes')) / 60))::int AS s FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), u AS (SELECT w, s, CASE WHEN s < 10000 THEN 1 WHEN s < 600000 THEN 60 ELSE 1440 END AS unit FROM b) SELECT (w + s % unit)::text || 'm' FROM u

list.name: trade_shift
list.query: WITH b AS (SELECT GREATEST(30, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(NOW(), COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) + interval '15 minutes') - (entry_time - interval '15 minutes')) / 60))::int AS w, GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - (COALESCE(exit_time, NOW()) + interval '15 minutes')) / 60))::int AS s FROM butterfly_trades WHERE underlying = '$underlying' AND id = $trade_id), u AS (SELECT w, s, CASE WHEN s < 10000 THEN 1 WHEN s < 600000 THEN 60 ELSE 1440 END AS unit FROM b) SELECT (s / unit)::text || CASE unit WHEN 1 THEN 'm' WHEN 60 THEN 'h' ELSE 'd' END FROM u

list.name: prev_trade_id
list.query: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT p.id FROM butterfly_trades p WHERE p.underlying = '$underlying' AND ('${strategy_datasource:raw}' = 'timescaledb' OR p.metadata->>'paper_fill_model' = 'mark_v1') AND p.entry_time < (SELECT entry_time FROM butterfly_trades WHERE id = $trade_id) ORDER BY p.entry_time DESC LIMIT 1), $trade_id)::text
